passives.name: Unstable Earth
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, inflicts Bleeding and Poisoned on the caster and all enemies for 9 turns. Increases the Speed of Healer and Defender enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_14]. Increases damage dealt to non-Earth enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
